admission: At least one fully replayed legal completion from the initial layout is required; not every legal choice must remain solvable. Free undo/reset remains available. Forward dead ends are reported, not a difficulty bonus. Mandatory midpoint, source, exact classic rating and public disclosure policy are separately verified.
